# Pharmaceutical R&D Dashboard

## Overview
This dashboard provides visibility into the clinical trial portfolio, regulatory submission pipeline, and R&D milestone progress. It enables research leaders to track enrollment rates, protocol adherence, and regulatory timelines across all active programs.

## Key Metrics
- Active Clinical Trials: 7
- Trial Enrollment Rate: 64.2%
- Milestone Completion Rate: 79.0%

## Insights
- CardioMax Phase III enrollment is 8% below target — site activation at two additional sites is underway.
- Protocol deviation rate of 3.8% is within acceptable thresholds but requires monitoring at Site 4.
- Four regulatory submissions are pending review; NovaDerm NDA is the highest priority.
